pins.title: 7 days, 5 parks
items: Days 1-2: Zion, Emerald Pools and The Narrows
Day 7: Mesa Arch and Delicate Arch
pins.sub: One road trip loop of about 500 miles, west to east, with the best hike in every park.

pins.title: Leave the cotton socks home
pins.sub: Cotton holds water and chills your feet. Wool socks stay warmer even when they get damp.

pins.title: Clear stream? Still filter it
pins.sub: Clean-looking water can carry bacteria and parasites like Giardia. Filter or treat every refill.

pins.title: Remember S.T.O.P.
pins.sub: Stop. Think. Observe. Plan. Stay calm, stay put if unsure, and don't wander off the trail.

pins.title: 5 best day hikes
pins.sub: No entrance fee, but parking over 15 minutes needs a $5 daily tag. Start early: lots fill fast.
